clothing.rule: Opaque presentation-sheet backgrounds and garment-interior mannequin fills are rejected. True paper-doll cutouts must expose body or inner layers where the garment is open.

hair.blocker: true hairless body master still required

rules.source_isolation: Reject neighboring-item pixels, labels, panel borders, presentation shadows, unrelated direction art, opaque sheet background, and opaque interior presentation fill.
rules.paper_doll_anchor: All character layers share the same 480x640 anatomical body lattice; do not independently center or bottom-justify them.
rules.runtime_gate: No 48x64 derivation until all eight v8 composites receive direction-specific seam/occlusion correction, a true hairless body exists, equipment is registered, and the four missing NW equipment views are authored.
